{{Quote|Six meters of muscle, teeth, and venom. Hyperfast reflexes and a vicious streak as wide as the Cron Drift. I'd say you're looking at the most efficient predator in history. My taxidermist just stuffed it this morning.|Tyro Viveca, on his new trophy|<ref name="FP" />}}
'''This Lamproid''' was present on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kabal/Legends|Kabal]] in [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]]. He had grey-green skin and white [[Tooth/Legends|fangs]]. He was [[Hunting/Legends|hunted]] down and [[Death/Legends|killed]] by the [[Krish (species)/Legends|Krish]] big-game hunter [[Tyro Viveca/Legends|Tyro Viveca]], who then had the body taxidermied. Viveca displayed the [[Lamproid/Legends|Lamproid]] as a trophy in his estate on that world. He had the Lamproid's body mounted to a [[Wood/Legends|wooden]] base and posed as if in mid-strike. The wealthy Krish showed off the dead Lamproid to [[Cecil Noone]].<ref name="FP" />

Viveca captured the Lamproid's [[Unidentified Lamproid (Kabal)|mate]], whom he sedated and locked in a [[force cage]]. Viveca intended to hunt her down at a later date.<ref name="FP" />
